//: What `tools/font/bake-ttf.mjs` bakes. One page per (font, size).
//pairs: The (colour, weight) stripes every page carries, in cell order. The framework's palette is 0=normal 1=muted 2=link 3=code 4=heading, weight 0=regular 1=bold. Each pair is 95 cells; a page with six is 570. Baking a pair nobody draws is 95 cells of dead VRAM per page, so this list is the knob.
